```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

source("00-paths.R")
```

read in cna buffa table with 93 gene matches
```{r}
df <- readRDS("../data/cna_buffa.rds")
```

expr level ~ cna category

# need to split by cancer

# using group by and do
```{r}
models = cna_buffa %>% group_by(Hugo_Symbol) %>% do(m = polr(value ~ BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, data = ., Hess = TRUE))
```

filter to buffa hypoxia score
```{r}
filt_output <- output %>%
  filter(grepl("BUFFA", rownames(output)))

filt_output$test <- ""
```

```{r}
ggplot(filt_output, aes(x=test , y=gene, fill=Value)) +
 geom_tile(color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#075AFF",
                       mid = "#FFFFCC",
                       high = "#FF0000") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") 
```
